description: Save a batch of answers to about_next's questions for one account. Each answer is a kind (topics, more_topics, audience, different, sounds_like, words, or confirm, edit, same_as) with the person's text. Free text is split at commas, "and" and line breaks and each part goes where it belongs; what is typed is never dropped. Returns one line per saved change (changes[].effect) to read back to the person. Writes carry the person's name when they typed it in the app and the assistant's otherwise; a person's value is never overwritten by an automatic one. Undo restores the account's niches, topics and voice, unless something newer was written to them.

account_id.description: The account the answers are for
same_as: the account whose setup to copy

caption.description: sounds_like: the caption tapped or pasted

emoji.description: words: none, some, lots, or short text such as only a stethoscope

kind.description: The question answered; confirm is Looks right; edit changes a row in the person's words; same_as copies the other account's setup; add_drift adds the niche in drift (picks: [l1/l2])

picks.description: topics and more_topics: niches tapped, as l1/l2

row.description: With confirm or edit: the row

text.description: Free text, split into parts; each part goes where it belongs and what is typed is never dropped

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: about_answer
title: Save answers about an account
